newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices ease, volume remains steady.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices ease, volume remains steady.

text.p: Istanbul's gold exchange saw steady trade on Monday with 1,051 kilos changing hands after Friday's 1,025 kilos on a combination of free market demand and arbitrage by banks, dealers said.
Gold closed easier at $351.00 an ounce and 1,430,500 lira per gram, compared to $353.00 and 1,437,000 lira on Friday following lower levels in European markets.

"There was some buying by free-market traders making up for stocks sold at the weekend, as well as a certain amount of arbitrage by the banks. I expect the market to stay fairly quiet until next month when demand should pick up," one dealer said.
Gold demand in Turkey is usually higher in the summer months and around Moslem religious holidays.
The lira eased against the dollar to close at 126,670 after 126,100 on Friday, helping the banks' arbitrage deals.
Most of the day's volume -- 806 kilos -- was done in the morning and 76.2 percent of total trade was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
